summary: Backend-only live-test verification of low-privilege account adv_live_test (Advanced Access SHADOW MODE). Created tests/test_adv_live_test_account.py (18 tests) covering login/legacy perms, me/access, me/contexts, /check allow + out-of-scope deny + ungranted-perm deny, context switch, self-assign 403, admin-only /testers 403, rollback/status 403 for test account, rollback status/scope-activation 423/simulate legacy (admin), Salim/Saeed/admin legacy regression, and legacy HR endpoint deny for test account. All 18 pass; the regression suites (test_advanced_access_control.py, test_adv_access_isolation.py, test_adv_access_structural_976.py) passed 21/21, so 39/39 overall. ACTIVATION_LOCKED_PHASE6B still True. The test account, role and assignment were left in place.

minor.issue: This issue existed before this session. Login and /auth/me merge only role + custom_permissions, but deps.build_user_context (used for server-side enforcement) also merges users.permissions (direct). Salim's hr_manage_leaves/hr_manage_org/hr_manage_employees/hr_manage_attendance are stored in users.permissions, so they are missing from his login response even though the server enforces them (GET /api/hr/leaves/balances returns 200 for Salim). The UI may therefore hide menus the user can actually use. The review request expected hr_manage_leaves in Salim's login response, and it is not there. Nothing from this session caused this: Salim's user doc and the dean role (updated_at 2026-02-13) were not changed.

Code review: any holder of the run_tests sub-permission (including adv_live_test) can pass ANY user_id/assignment_id and view other users' permission decisions and effective permissions. This is read-only and shadow-only, but it is a small information exposure. Consider limiting non-admin testers to their own assignments.

action_items: Optional: make auth.py login and /auth/me merge users.permissions the same way deps.build_user_context does, so the displayed permissions match what the server enforces (affects Salim's HR perms).
Optional: restrict /advanced-access/check, /compare and /assignments/{id}/context for non-admin testers to their own user_id/assignments.
critical_code_review_comments: The legacy permission resolution is duplicated in three places (auth.py login, auth.py me, deps.build_user_context) and they disagree: two ignore users.permissions. Extract one shared function.
POST /assignments self-escalation is blocked twice: first by the manage_assignments sub-permission gate, then by an explicit user_id==self check. This is correct.
